shared_elements: linear bands or repeated line marks
justification: The most specific shared content is the use of schematic human/anthropomorphic forms combined with circular or concentric disc-like motifs and simple incised/drawn linear marks. The biggest difference is that A presents a single frontal, solid-bodied figure with torso decoration, while B is a dispersed scene of stick figures, animals, boats, dotted lines, and spiral signs with no comparable central body arrangement.
